current_task_corrections.correction: Change denial_rate component parameter denominator from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to exclude pending claims and correctly compute the denial rate.
Change monthly_trend component parameter date_column from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to key the monthly volume trend on when care began, avoiding adjudication date lag.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When computing denial rates in claims analysis, use adjudicated_claims as the denominator (claim statuses Paid, Denied, and Adjusted), excluding pending claims that have not yet been decided. Including pending claims understates the denial rate and violates statistical discipline.

When analyzing monthly trends in claims portfolios, key the monthly series on service_date_from (when care began) rather than adjudication_date. Adjudication dates lag service dates and can introduce inconsistencies; service_date_from provides a more reliable basis for trend analysis.
